name: Kujou Takami
source:
A young man who is slightly older than Rei and heir to the Kujou family business of slave-trading after his father's death in an accident. Gets embarrassed when his masculinity is in question.

[From [url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t74083-review-of-rashiel%27s-riddle.html]Aarinfantasy Forums[/url]]
